claim: The core motion verb of the shot - what the camera does across its duration, from a locked static to a whip pan. It is the single loudest choice in a moving shot and the one directors name first.
not_visual: All twenty values describe motion over time. A still cannot separate push from zoom_in, pan_l from pan_r, or orbit from dolly; at best every panel picks up generic motion blur and the card teaches nothing.
